source.query: SELECT C319.C225 AS C250, C319.C318, C319.C320 FROM C095.C321 AS C319
SELECT C335.C336, SUBSTRING(C335.C336, 7, 8) AS C337, TRIM(SUBSTRING(C335.C338, 9, 10)) AS C234 FROM C095.C339 C335 WHERE C335.C340 = 'V020' AND C335.C341 = 'V021'

SELECT DISTINCT C342.C336, TRIM(SUBSTRING(C342.C336, 11, 12)) AS C343, TRIM(SUBSTRING(C342.C338, 6, 13)) AS C234 FROM C095.C339 C342 WHERE C342.C341 = 'V017' AND C342.C340 = 'V022' AND SUBSTRING(C342.C336, 6, 14) = 'V023' AND PATINDEX('V024', TRIM(SUBSTRING(C342.C336, 11, 12))) <= 5

SELECT C335.C340 AS C250, C335.C341 AS C168, SUBSTRING(C335.C336, 15, 2) AS C348, ISNULL(SUBSTRING(C335.C338, 6, 16), '') C349 FROM C095.C339 AS C335 WHERE C335.C340 = 'V027'

SELECT C683.C104 AS C682, TRIM(C683.C059) AS C684, Case when C683.C685 <> '' then 'V089' when C683.C685 = '' AND C683.C686 = 'V090' then 'V091' when C683.C685 = '' AND C683.C686 = 'V092' then 'V093' when C683.C685 = '' AND C683.C686 = 'V019' then 'V094' when C683.C685 = '' AND C683.C686 = 'V095' then 'V096' when C683.C685 = '' AND C683.C686 = 'V097' then 'V098' when C683.C685 = '' AND C683.C686 = 'V016' then 'V099' when C683.C685 = '' AND C683.C686 = 'V100' then 'V101' ELSE 'V102' end AS C687, C688.C689 AS C690 FROM C095.C102 C683 LEFT OUTER JOIN C095.C691 C688 ON (C683.C103 = C688.C692 AND C683.C104 = C688.C693) WHERE C683.C103 = 'V017'

SELECT DISTINCT C708.C201 AS C706, C708.C202 as C707, C708.C709 as C026, TRIM(C708.C710) AS C234, TRIM(C708.C711) AS C018, TRIM(C708.C712) AS C020, TRIM(C708.C713) AS C022, C708.C714 AS C024 FROM C095.C200 AS C708 WHERE C708.C202 <> 'V012' AND TRIM(C708.C202) != 'V104'
